```bash
tail -50 /root/distill_sparse_swiglu/logs/perlayer_kl_k8_s42.log
```

```bash
ls -la /root/distill_sparse_swiglu/checkpoints/perlayer_kl_k8_s42/

### 产出
在完成时汇总：训练是否正常完成、final metrics、PPL eval 结果、conclusion 判断。
